name: Eden
source: You and you "not-girlfriend-but-she's-basically-your-girlfriend" go on a date and end up in a hotel room getting... frisky. After a very fun night of hand-holding and other atrocious acts like that, you realize that you are somehow stuck in said hotel room. By solving puzzles, you leave the hotel room... only to realize you've been... isekai'd? Go on a fantastic adventure with our 4 lovely LIs: Natasha, Gianna, Yuki, and Ravena in Eden!
translation: 你和你“不是女朋友，但她基本上是你的女朋友”去约会，最后在酒店房间里变得……热闹起来。经过一个非常有趣的夜晚的牵手和其他类似的残暴行为之后，你意识到你不知何故被困在上述酒店房间里。通过解决谜题，你离开酒店房间……却发现你已经……异世界了？与我们的4位可爱的LI一起在伊甸园进行奇妙的冒险：Natasha、Gianna、Yuki和Ravena！
